tasks.title: Data model of the core entities
tasks.description: Goal: the entities of docs/spec.md section 3 with validation at construction. Out of scope: persistence. Done when every entity rejects invalid input with an error naming the field and the fix, and the tests cover each rule. Pitfall: no silent defaults for physically meaningful fields.

tasks.title: Gate G1: owner decisions and review of the data model
tasks.description: Owner steps: (1) answer the open questions raised by M1-001; (2) review the error messages of the data model; (3) pass the gate with 'python harness/owner_tools.py pass_gate task=M1-G1'.

tasks.title: Serialisation of the data model
tasks.description: Goal: read and write the model as JSON, round trip exact. Out of scope: versioning. Done when every entity round-trips and a malformed file gives an error naming the path in the file.

tasks.title: Gate G2: end of milestone
tasks.description: Owner steps: ratify or override the provisional decisions; review the milestone; merge the branch into main.
